importOrder.description: The order of the groups of imports, as regular expressions of module names. `<THIRD_PARTY_MODULES>` is the modules that match none. With `"ianvs"`, `<BUILTIN_MODULES>` is Node's modules, `<TYPES>` marks type imports, and `""` puts a blank line between two groups. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"` or `"ianvs"`.

importOrderCaseInsensitive.description: Ignore case when sorting. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderCaseSensitive.description: Sort with case sensitivity. Only with `sortImports` set to `"ianvs"`.

importOrderExclude.description: Files whose imports stay as they are, as globs. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderGroupNamespaceSpecifiers.description: Put namespace imports first in their group. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderImportAttributesKeyword.description: The keyword of import attributes. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderParserPlugins.description: The Babel plugins of the original plugin. With `"ianvs"`, type and value imports of a module combine only if it holds `typescript`. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"` or `"ianvs"`.

importOrderSafeSideEffects.description: Side-effect imports that may move, as regular expressions of module names. Only with `sortImports` set to `"ianvs"`.

importOrderSeparation.description: A blank line between the groups of `importOrder`. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderSideEffects.description: Sort side-effect imports too. Otherwise, no import moves across one. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderSortByLength.description: Sort by the length of the import, not by name. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderSortSpecifiers.description: Sort the names inside braces. Only with `sortImports` set to `"trivago"`.

importOrderTypeScriptVersion.description: The project's TypeScript version. Type and value imports of a module combine from 4.5.0. Only with `sortImports` set to `"ianvs"`.

objectWrap.description: Keep an object expanded when the source had a line break after `{`.

organizeImportsSkipDestructiveCodeAction.description: Keep the imports that are not used. Only with `sortImports` set to `"organize-imports"`.

organizeImportsTypeOrder.description: Where type imports go among the names inside braces. Default: as TypeScript does. Only with `sortImports` set to `"organize-imports"`.

anyOf.description: Sort as `true` does, with these options.

customGroups.description: Groups of your own, which `groups` can name. An import goes to the first group it matches, before the predefined ones.

elementNamePattern.description: Globs that the module name must match.

groupName.description: The name that `groups` gives the group.

modifiers.description: Properties that the import must all have.

groups.description: The groups, in order: predefined ones, such as `builtin`, `external`, `internal`, `parent`, `sibling`, `index`, `style` and `unknown`, or the names of `customGroups`. An array sorts its groups as one. A `newlinesBetween` object between two groups overrides `newlinesBetween` there.

partitionByComment.description: Sort the imports between comments apart.

partitionByNewline.description: Sort the imports between blank lines apart.

sortSideEffects.description: Sort side-effect imports too. Otherwise, no import moves across one.

anyOf.title: SortImports

sortImports.description: Sort imports: `true` as `bun fmt` does, or as `"trivago"` (`@trivago/prettier-plugin-sort-imports`), `"ianvs"` (`@ianvs/prettier-plugin-sort-imports`) or `"organize-imports"` (`prettier-plugin-organize-imports`) does. `true` never moves an import across a side-effect import.
